comparison.objective: PR-1673 extracts one interfolded tissue while leaving the next presented and the light box in place; the candidate commissions a rigid industrial shock absorber through adjustment and dynamic cycling.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1673 uses deformable-sheet pinching, friction-sensitive pulling, box counterholding, and cloth placement. The candidate uses rigid-body hex-key insertion, captive-lock manipulation, collar rotation, bounded tightening, control actuation, and dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1673 scores first-sheet extraction/tray placement, second-sheet presentation, box pose, release, and stillness, with failures for tipping or extracting both sheets. The candidate scores two non-bottoming, non-overload stops and post-lock setting retention. Its rebound, overload, drift, and witness-torque thresholds are undeclared but unrelated to the tissue rubric.
comparison.reason: Deformable interfold separation and rigid damper commissioning test different core physical abilities and outcomes.
